title: Molecular and structural basis of anti-DNA antibody specificity for pyrrolated proteins.
authors: Anan, Yusuke; Itakura, Masanori; Shimoda, Tatsuya; Yamaguchi, Kosuke; Lu, Peng; Nagata, Koji; Dong, Jinhua; Ueda, Hiroshi; Uchida, Koji
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过噬菌体展示和晶体学/计算机模拟解析抗DNA抗体与吡咯化蛋白的交叉反应机制，虽涉及蛋白-核酸结合界面，但对象为抗体而非转录因子，且方法以实验为主、模拟为辅，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: Anti-DNA antibodies (Abs), serological hallmarks of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and markers for diagnosis and disease activity, show a specificity for non-nucleic acid molecules, such as N-pyrrolated proteins (pyrP) containing N(epsilon)-pyrrole-L-lysine (pyrK) residues. However, the detailed mechanism for the binding of anti-DNA Abs to pyrP remains unknown. In the present study, to gain structural insights into the dual-specificity of anti-DNA Abs, we used phage display to obtain DNA-binding, single-chain variable fragments (scFvs) from SLE-prone mice and found that they also cross-reacted with pyrP. It was revealed that a variable heavy chain (VH) domain is sufficient for the recognition of DNA/pyrP. Identification of an antigenic sequence containing pyrK in pyrP suggested that the presence of both pyrK and multiple acidic amino acid residues plays important roles in the electrostatic interactions with the Abs. X-ray crystallography and computer-predicted simulations of the pyrK-containing peptide-scFv complexes identified key residues of Abs involved in the interaction with the antigens. These data provide a mechanistic insight into the molecular basis of the dual-specificity of the anti-DNA Abs and provide a basis for therapeutic intervention against SLE.
abstract_zh: 抗DNA抗体（Abs）是系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）的血清学标志物，也是诊断和疾病活动性的标记，其对非核酸分子表现出特异性，例如含有N(ε)-吡咯-L-赖氨酸（pyrK）残基的N-吡咯化蛋白（pyrP）。然而，抗DNA抗体与pyrP结合的详细机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，为了从结构上理解抗DNA抗体的双重特异性，我们使用噬菌体展示技术从SLE易感小鼠中获得了DNA结合的单链可变片段（scFvs），并发现它们也与pyrP发生交叉反应。结果表明，可变重链（VH）结构域足以识别DNA/pyrP。对pyrP中含pyrK抗原序列的鉴定提示，pyrK和多个酸性氨基酸残基的存在在与抗体的静电相互作用中发挥重要作用。通过X射线晶体学和计算机预测模拟含pyrK肽-scFv复合物，我们确定了抗体中参与抗原相互作用的关键残基。这些数据为抗DNA抗体双重特异性的分子基础提供了机制性见解，并为针对SLE的治疗干预提供了基础。
